title: THE 4AM PRAYER THAT SHIFTS THE ATMOSPHERE OVER YOUR ENTIRE HOUSEHOLD
text: Glory to Jesus Christ. Somebody give the Lord a hand. We are gathered here in the name of the almighty God. This is not accident. The spirit of the Lord is moving. What God is about to do in the next few moments will reposition entire families. Household atmospheres will shift. Generational curses will break. The question is not whether God can do it. The question is whether you will partner with him through prayer and declaration. Let me begin with a word that the spirit has placed deep in my spirit. Someone listening to this word and I want you to understand this word is not for casual listening. This word demands response. This word demands partnership with heaven. What we discuss today will require your commitment. It will require your vigilance. It will require you to become a watchman over your own house. Listen to Proverbs 8:15. By me kings reign and rulers make laws that are just. Do you understand what this means? >> [music] >> There is a dimension of authority that you have been given over your own household that you have never fully exercised. You have a kingship over your house. You have dominion. But that dominion must be established through prayer. That dominion must be enforced through declaration. That dominion must be guarded through vigilance. The theme that God has impressed upon my heart this morning is this. The 4:00 a.m. prayer that shifts the atmosphere over your entire household. And I want you to understand this is not religious talk. This is not sentimental Christianity. This is warfare. This is kingdom assignment. The atmosphere over your house is either established by you or it is being established against you. Let me tell you something that the spirit is burning in my heart right now. There are families that pray, yes. But their prayers are weak because their prayers are not strategic. There are families that have devotions, yes, but those devotions have no teeth because there is no warfare in them. There is no decree, there is no declaration, there is no commanding of the gates, there is no breaking of altars. But listen carefully. When the sun goes down over your house, there is a transition that happens in the spirit realm. When midnight comes, there is an opening. When 4 inches in the morning arrives, that is the hour when the veil is thinnest. That is the hour when heaven is most responsive. That is the hour when the Holy Ghost will move most powerfully on behalf of a family that dares to pray. Turn with me to Psalm 119, verse 148. My eyes stay open through the watches of the night that I may meditate on your promises. David understood something. There is power in the night watches. There is a dimension of spiritual activity that happens when the world sleeps, but the intercessor is awake. When your household is sleeping, but you are awake in prayer, something shifts. Something changes. The atmosphere begins to transform. And I want to tell you this morning with absolute clarity, your household atmosphere is not determined by your circumstances, your household atmosphere is not determined by your salary, your household atmosphere is not determined by your education, your household atmosphere is determined by the spiritual authority that is exercised within those walls. And that authority is exercised through prayer. That authority is exercised through decree. That authority is exercised through fasting. That authority is exercised when you stand in the gap for your family. Thus said the spirit of God, there are families right now that are under siege. There are families right now where the enemy has established strongholds. There are families where there is strife. There are families where there is sickness. There are families where there is backsliding. There are families where there is financial strangulation, and [music] the enemy whispers, "This is your destiny. This is your portion. This is what you deserve." But, God is raising up a people who will not accept the lies of the enemy. God is raising up intercessors who will stand in the 4 inches the morning and decree that the siege is over. God is raising up mothers and fathers who will establish the kingdom of God over their household through prayer and fasting. Let me establish something in your understanding. When Jesus taught the disciples to pray, he said in Matthew 6:10, "Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven." Do you understand what that means? You are an ambassador of the kingdom of God in your household. You are not just living there. You are not just existing there. You are establishing the kingdom of God in that territory. And that establishment happens through prayer. Listen. There are dimensions to the power of 4:00 a.m. prayer that most believers have never understood. [music] Listen carefully now. Most prayers are prayed in the day. Most prayers are prayed when the mind is active, when the body is strong, when the flesh wants to resist. But, when 4:00 inches the morning comes, listen carefully, the flesh is weak. >> [music] >> The distractions are gone. The noise of the world has ceased. And if you will arise and pray in that hour, something happens. The spirit of God moves in a way that he does not move at other times. I'm talking about a prayer that is not rote. I'm not talking about memorized words. >> [music] >> I'm talking about a prayer that comes from the depths of your spirit. I'm talking about a prayer that flows from revelation. I am talking about a prayer that is empowered by the Holy Ghost. That kind of prayer in the 4 inches the morning changes the atmosphere. What does atmosphere mean? It means the mood, it means the spiritual climate, it means the dominion that is established. When you enter a house, you feel something. You feel whether love is there or strife is there, you feel whether peace is there or anxiety is there, you feel whether the presence of God is there or the presence of darkness is there. That is the atmosphere. And that atmosphere is not created by accident. That atmosphere is created by prayer or the lack of prayer. There are houses where the spirit of God is so thick you can almost touch it. There are houses where you walk in and immediately you feel the presence of Jesus. Why? Because someone in that house is praying. Someone is standing in the gap, someone is decreeing, someone is breaking altars, someone is commanding the gates. And then there are houses where you walk in and immediately you feel heaviness, you feel oppression, you feel something is wrong, you feel the enemy has set up camp. Why? Because the prayer shield has been broken, because no one is enforcing the kingdom, because there is no spiritual father or mother standing in the authority of God. Listen, listen to me carefully. When your children sleep at night, they sleep under an atmosphere that you have created through prayer. When your spouse rests, they rest under a covering that you have established through intercession. When your elderly parents are in your house, they are living under a spiritual protection or a spiritual vulnerability that you have determined through your prayer life. Do you understand the weight of that responsibility? Do you understand what it means to be a spiritual father or a spiritual mother? Let me take you to Luke 1:8-10. This is about Zachariah, the father of John the Baptist. Once when Zechariah's division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God, he was chosen by lot according to the custom of the priesthood to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense. And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside. Do you see that? There is a connection between the priest burning incense and the people praying outside. The incense goes up, the prayer goes up, and something happens in the heavens. Every father in here is a priest in his own house. Every mother in here is an intercessor for her own family. And when you pray, when you decree, when you stand in the authority of God, you are burning incense before the throne of the almighty, and that incense is rising up, that prayer is being heard, and heaven is responding. Now, let me tell you what happens when 4 inches the morning comes and you are awake in prayer. >> [music] >> Listen carefully. The enemy knows that this is a strategic hour. The enemy knows that this is a time when the veil is thin. The enemy knows that this is a time when heaven is particularly responsive to the prayers of the righteous. This is why the enemy fights so hard to keep you asleep. This is why he floods your mind with concerns. This is why he whispers, "You are tired. You need your rest. You cannot wake up at 4 inches the morning." But, I want to tell you something this morning. The spirit of God is raising up a generation of believers who will not allow the enemy to dictate their prayer schedule. Who will not allow the enemy to determine when they pray? Who will arise in the 4 inches the morning and decree that the atmosphere over their household is shifting? Who will stand in faith and declare that the siege is broken? Who will command the gates of their house to open to righteousness and close to wickedness? And when you do that, listen to me carefully. When you stand in that hour and you pray with authority, with decree, with the fire of the Holy Ghost burning in your spirit, something happens. The enemy loses ground. The spiritual climate changes. The protective barrier around your family strengthens. The blessing of God begins to flow. Sickness begins to break. Strive begins to dissolve. Financial barriers begin to crumble. The destiny of your children begins to be restored. Let me give you a scripture that will shake your foundation. Go with me to Ephesians 6:18 and 19. And pray in the spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and petitions. For this, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord's people. And pray also for me that whenever I speak words may be given me so that I fearlessly make known the mystery of the gospel. Do you see the word alert? Do you see the instruction to keep on praying? This is not casual Christianity. This is not something you do when you have time. This is an urgent mandate. >> [music] >> You must be alert. You must be vigilant. You must understand that your prayer is not just for you. Your prayer is a weapon. Your prayer is warfare. Your prayer determines the spiritual fate of your household. And I want to tell you something this morning that might be uncomfortable. There are many families that are not blessed because the head of that family >> [music] >> has abdicated his prayer responsibility. There are many children that are not prospering because no one is praying over their destiny. >> [music] >> There are many wives that are struggling because their husbands have not established prayer as the foundation of the family. There are many young people that are backsliding because there is no one interceding for their souls. But God is calling forth a remnant. God is calling for those who will not compromise. God is calling for those who will arise in the 4 inches of the morning and say enough, the siege is over. The curse is broken. The atmosphere is changing. My family is entering into blessing. [music] My children are walking in righteousness. My spouse is covered with the protection of the almighty. Every altar that has been raised against my house catches fire and burns to ashes. Let me tell you what the Holy Ghost wants you to understand about the spiritual authority you possess. Turn to Joshua 1:8. Keep this book of the law always on your lips. Meditate on it day and night so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful. Joshua is about to take the land. Joshua is about to face enemies that are stronger than him. Joshua is about to confront situations that seem impossible. And God says, keep my word [music] on your lips. Meditate on it day and night. This is not an optional exercise. This is the foundation of success. This is how you take territory. This is how you establish dominion. And I am telling you this morning, your household is your territory. Your family is your assignment. And you will establish dominion over that territory not through the strength of your arm, but through the power of the word of God on your lips. Through meditation, through declaration, through decree. When you wake up at 4 inches of the morning, the first thing that should come out of your mouth is not complaining. It is not anxiety. It is not worry. It is the word of God. It is declaration. It is decree. My house is a house of blessing. My family is protected by the blood of Jesus. My children walk in righteousness. My spouse is covered with the favor of the almighty. Every demon assigned to my household flees now in the name of Jesus. Listen to what happened in Acts 4:23-31. Peter and John were released from prison and they went to the believers and reported everything. And when they heard it, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. Listen carefully. Sovereign Lord, you made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them. You said through the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant our father David, "Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain? The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one." And then listen to what happened. After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly. Do you understand what that means? When the believers prayed, the physical place was shaken, the atmosphere was altered, the spiritual climate was transformed, and everyone in that place was filled with boldness. This is what happens when prayer is prayed with power. This is what happens when decrees released with authority. This is what happens when people refuse to accept the lies of the enemy. And I want to tell you this morning, this can happen in your household. When you stand in the 4 inches the morning and you pray with the authority that God has given you, the atmosphere of your house can be shaken. The spiritual climate can be transformed, your family can be filled with boldness, your children can walk in courage, your spouse can be strengthened, but listen to me, there is a condition, there is a requirement. [music] You cannot do this in rebellion against God. You cannot do this while harboring unforgiveness. You cannot do this while engaging in sin. You cannot do this while your marriage is fractured and you are not seeking reconciliation. You cannot do this while you are abusing your authority. You cannot do this while you are not honoring the word of God in your own life. Thus said the spirit of God, before you can shift the atmosphere over your household, you must allow the atmosphere of your own heart to be shifted. You must allow the Holy Ghost to convict you. You must allow the word of God to search your spirit. You must repent of your own sins. You must forgive those who have hurt you. You must reconcile where reconciliation is needed. You must restore integrity to your own life. Because listen carefully, the authority you exercise in prayer is directly proportional to the obedience you exercise in living. A man who is cheating on his wife has no authority to pray for his family. A woman who is harboring unforgiveness has no authority to decree blessings. A parent who is abusing their children has no authority to command the gates of their house. The authority to pray must be backed by the integrity of your living. This is why Jesus said in Matthew 5:23 and 24, "Therefore, if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you, leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled to them, then come and offer your gift." Your prayer is your gift. Your decree is your offering. But if your relationships are fractured, if your integrity is compromised, if you are living in rebellion, then your gift is not acceptable. Your offering is not received. Your prayer has no power. So, the first thing that must happen in the 4 inches the morning is not just prayer, it is repentance. It is confession. It is alignment with God. It is saying, "God, search my heart. Reveal anything in me that is displeasing to you. Show me where I have compromised. Show me where I have been unfaithful. Show me where I have abdicated my responsibility. Show me where I have allowed the enemy to establish strongholds. And when you pray that prayer, when you truly invite God to search your heart and reveal sin, something happens. The cleansing begins. The restoration begins. The authority begins to be restored. Let me give you a picture of what this looks like. Turn to 2 Chronicles 7:14 and 15. If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land. Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place. Do you see the progression? Humble yourself, pray, seek my face, turn from wickedness, and then God says, "I will hear, I will forgive, I will heal, and then my eyes will be open. My ears will be attentive." This means that your prayers will be heard, your decrees will be received, your intercession will be honored. This is the foundation. This is where the 4 inches the morning prayer begins. It begins with humility, it begins with confession, it begins with repentance, [music] it begins with alignment. And I want to tell you something this morning that might challenge you. There are believers who are praying long prayers, there are believers who are using big words. There are believers who are using scriptural language, >> [music] >> but their prayers are not being answered because their hearts are not aligned with God. Their lives are not aligned with God. There is a disconnect between what they are praying and how they are living, but God is looking for a different kind of intercessor. God is looking for those who will pray the prayers of the righteous. James 5:16 says, "The prayer of a righteous person is powerful [music] and effective. Not the prayer of the eloquent person, not the prayer of the person who uses big words, the prayer of the righteous person, a [music] person whose life is submitted to God, a person whose marriage is founded on God, a person whose children are being raised according to God's word, a person whose work is done with integrity, a person whose dealings are honest, that person's prayer has power. So, when you wake up at 4:00 in the morning, before you pray for anyone else, before you decree for anyone else, examine yourself. Say, "God, am I walking in righteousness? Am I honoring my commitments? Am I treating my family with love and respect? Am I dealing honestly in my business? Am I guarding my words? Am I protecting my eyes? Am I submitting to authority?" And if you discover that you are not, then confess it, repent of it, ask God to forgive you, ask God to restore your integrity. And then, from a place of alignment, from a place of righteousness, from a place of submission, begin to pray for your household. Now, let me shift into what the actual prayer looks like. What does a 4:00 in the morning prayer that shifts the atmosphere over your entire household look like? First, it is a prayer of authority. It is not tentative, it is not asking, it is declaring, it is decreeing, it is commanding. You are not begging God to protect your house. God has already given you the authority to protect your house. You are exercising that authority. You are commanding the gates, you are breaking the altars, you are declaring the boundaries. Listen to what Jesus said in Matthew 16:18-19. "And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it. I will give you the the of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven. Do you understand what that means? You have been given keys. You have authority to bind, you have authority to loose, you have authority to open and to close. This is not just for apostles. This is for every believer, every father, every mother, every child of God who understands their authority in Christ. When you stand at 4:00 in the morning and you say, "I bind every demon assigned to my household. I bind every spirit of infirmity. I bind every spirit of poverty. I bind every spirit of lust. I bind every spirit of rebellion. I bind every spirit of witchcraft." This is not just words. This is the exercise of authority that Jesus has given you. And when you say, "I loose the protection of the almighty God over my household. I loose the blessing of the Lord. I loose the favor of God. I loose healing. I loose financial increase. I loose wisdom. I loose the anointing of the Holy Ghost." This is the exercise of your authority in Christ. So, the first element of a 4:00 in the morning prayer is authority. You are not asking, you are decreeing, you are not begging, you are commanding. You are standing in the position that God has given you, and you are exercising the authority that Christ has purchased for you. Let me tell you something that will shake your understanding. There are demons that are trembling right now as I speak these words. There are principalities that are hearing what the spirit is saying, and they are afraid. Why? Because somewhere someone is going to wake up at 4:00 in the morning and they are going to understand their authority. They are going to stand up and they are going to decree, and the kingdom of darkness will loose ground. The second element of a 4:00 in the morning prayer is specificity. You do not pray vague prayers. You do not pray general prayers. You pray specific prayers. You name the situation. You address the demon. You declare the blessing. You speak to the condition. For instance, if there is strife in your marriage, you do not just pray, "Bless my marriage." You [music] pray specifically, "I break the spirit of unforgiveness between my husband and me. I bind the spirit of offense. I command the walls of separation to crumble. I loose forgiveness. I loose compassion. I loose understanding. I speak to the heart of my husband and I say, 'You are loved. You are valued. You are the head of this household.' I speak to my own heart and I say, 'I will honor my husband. I will respect my husband. I will submit to his leadership.' When you pray with specificity, something happens. The prayer becomes focused. The authority becomes concentrated. The decree becomes powerful. The atmosphere begins to shift in that specific area. Third element of 4-in the morning prayer is a prayer of faith. This means you are not praying to see if God will do it. You are not praying with doubt. You are not praying with uncertainty. You are praying as if it is already done. You are speaking as if the situation has already been changed. You are decreeing as if the blessing has already been released. Listen to Mark 11:24. Jesus said, "Therefore, I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours." Not believe that you will receive it. Believe that you have received it. This is a present reality. When you pray in the 4-in the morning, you are praying from a position of faith. You are standing in the promise. You are speaking from the reality of what God has promised, not from the reality of your circumstances. Your circumstances are saying, "My child is still rebellious." Your faith is saying, "My child is returning to God." Your circumstances are saying, "My marriage is broken." Your faith is saying, "My marriage [music] is being restored." Your circumstances are saying, "I am broke." Your faith is saying, "I am prospering." Your circumstances are saying, "I am sick." Your faith is saying, "I am healed." This is not denial of your circumstances. This is superseding your circumstances with the reality of God's word. This is standing in faith. This is praying the prayers of the victorious. Fourth element, a 4 in the morning prayer is a prayer soaked in scripture. You are not praying your own words, you are praying the word of God. You are taking the promises of God and you are declaring them over your household. You are taking the commandments of God and you are applying them to your situation. You are taking the power of God's word and you are releasing it in your household. For example, you might pray, "God, you said in Psalm 91 that whoever dwells in the shelter of the most high will rest in the shadow of the almighty. I declare that my household dwells in your shelter. I declare that my family rests in your shadow. I declare that no plague will come near my dwelling. [music] I declare that you have commanded your angels concerning my house to guard it in all its ways. I declare that my family is protected by the most high God. When you pray like that, you are not creating words, you are releasing the power of God's word. You are activating the promise. You are establishing the reality in the spirit realm before it manifests in the natural realm. Fifth element, a 4 in the morning prayer is a prayer of warfare. This means you understand that you are not just praying, you are fighting, you are standing in battle, you are commanding the armies of God. You are declaring the defeat of the enemy. You are prophesying the end of the siege. Listen to Ephesians 6:10-12. Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the full armor of God so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes. For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms. This is not metaphorical. This is literal. You are in a war. Your household is in a war. There are real demons. There are real principalities. There are real powers of darkness arrayed against your family. And you must fight. You must stand. You must use the weapons that God has given you. So, your 4 in the morning prayer includes declarations like, "I stand in the authority of Jesus Christ. I declare the blood of Jesus over my household. I bind every demon. I command every principality to bow to the name of Jesus. I declare that the kingdom of God has come over my house. I declare that the light of Christ fills every room. I declare that darkness has no place here. I command witchcraft to lose its power. I command curses to break. I command evil altars to be destroyed. These are not soft prayers. These are warrior prayers. These are prayers that shake the heavens. These are prayers that shift the atmosphere. Sixth element, a 4 in the morning prayer includes Thanksgiving. You are not just asking and decreeing. You are also praising. You are also thanking God. You are celebrating what God has done, is doing, [music] and will do. Philippians 4:4-7 says, "Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again, rejoice. Let your gentleness be evident to all. The Lord is near. Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition with Thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus." Do you see it? With Thanksgiving, present your requests. Thanksgiving is not something that comes after the blessing. Thanksgiving is something that comes before the blessing. During the intercession, as an act of faith, you are thanking God for what he's going to do. So, you might pray, "Thank you, Lord, for protecting my household. Thank you for the blessing that is coming over my family. Thank you for the breakthrough that is manifesting. Thank you for the healing that is flowing. Thank you for the financial increase that is coming. Thank you for the reconciliation that is happening. Thank you, Jesus, for all that you are doing." This Thanksgiving creates an atmosphere of faith. This Thanksgiving opens the heavens. This Thanksgiving invites the blessings of God to flow. Seventh element, if 4 inches the morning prayer includes intercession for others. You are not just praying for yourself and your household, you are standing in the gap for others. You are praying for the lost. You are praying for the sick. You are praying for the nations. You are praying for those in authority. You are extending your intercession beyond your four walls. Listen to 1 Timothy 2:1-4. I urge, then, first of all, that requests, petitions, intercession, and Thanksgiving be made for all people, for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness. This is good and pleases God our savior, who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth. When you intercede for others, something happens. The spirit of God uses your prayer to touch lives that you may never even know about. Your prayer becomes a bridge between the kingdom of God and the souls of men. Your intercession becomes a vehicle for God's grace. So, at 4:00 inches the morning, after you have dealt with your own household, you pray for your community, you pray for your nation, you pray for the lost and the backsliding, you pray for the sick and the suffering, you pray for revival and reformation, you extend your prayer beyond your immediate family and you touch the whole world. These are the elements of a 4:00 inches the morning prayer that shifts the atmosphere. Now, let me tell you what this actually sounds like. Let me give you the prayer itself. Let me give you the words. Let me give you the decree. But, before I do that, I want to say this. The words I am about to pray are not magical. The words themselves are not the power. The power is in the authority behind the words. The power is in the submission to God that allows those words to be prayed. >> [music] >> The power is in the faith that refuses to accept the lies of the enemy. The power is in the alignment with God's kingdom. The power is in [music] the decree of a righteous person. So, when you pray these words, do not just repeat them like a ritual. Understand them, feel them, own them, believe them, stand in them, declare them with the fire of the Holy Ghost burning in your spirit. >> [music] >> Now, let me give you the actual prayer. This is a 4:00 inches the morning household prayer that will shift the atmosphere. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come before you at this hour in the authority that you have given me, I stand as a spiritual father over my household. I stand as the authority that God has established, [music] and I declare that the atmosphere over my house is now changing. I take authority over every demon assigned to my household, and I command you to flee. I command every spirit of infirmity to leave. I command every spirit of poverty to depart. I command every spirit of lust, every spirit of rebellion, every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of pride, every spirit of anger, every spirit of unforgiveness to lose its power and to flee from this place. In the name of Jesus Christ, I decree that my household is a house of blessing. I decree that my house is a house of righteousness. I decree that my house is a house of prayer. I decree that my house is a house of deliverance. I decree that my house is a house of healing. I decree that my house is a house of restoration. I decree that my house is a house of the presence of the almighty God. By the blood of Jesus Christ, I cover my household. I cover my spouse. I cover my children. I cover my parents. I cover every person under my roof. The blood of Jesus is a shield around my family. The blood of Jesus is a protection against every demon. The blood of Jesus breaks every curse. The blood of Jesus restores every blessing. I bind every evil altar that has been raised against my family, and I command it to be destroyed. Every demonic work that has been established against my household is broken now. Every curse that has been spoken over my children is shattered now. Every agreement that my ancestors made with darkness is canceled now. Every spiritual debt is paid. Every spiritual bondage is broken. I lose the blessing of the almighty God over my household. I loose healing over my family. I loose financial blessing. I loose wisdom. I loose understanding. I loose joy. I loose peace. I loose the anointing of the Holy Ghost. I loose the favor of God. I loose the presence of Jesus. I loose everything that God has promised to those who love him. I command the gates of my household to be open to righteousness and to close to wickedness. I command the gates to receive the king of glory. I command the gates to shut out every demon. I command every demonic messenger to be turned back from my house. I command every surveillance of darkness to be blinded. I command every plan of the enemy against my family to fail. I speak to the atmosphere over my house and I declare, this is holy ground. This is God's territory. This is the kingdom of God established in earth. This atmosphere is clean. This atmosphere is pure. This atmosphere is filled with the presence of Jesus Christ. I speak to my family and I declare, you are blessed, you are loved, you are protected, you are destined for greatness, you are called by God, you are chosen, you are sealed with the Holy Spirit. Your purpose will be fulfilled. Your destiny will be accomplished. Your life will glorify God. I speak to my spouse and I declare, you are the head of this household. You are the priest of this family. You are loved and honored. You are covered with the protection of the almighty. Your leadership is blessed. Your decisions are guided by God's wisdom. >> [music] >> Your life will be a testimony to the faithfulness of God. I speak to my children and I declare, you will walk in the ways of God. You will choose righteousness. You will embrace the destiny that God has for you. You will not be deceived by the lies of the enemy. You will be protected from every danger. You will prosper in every area of your life. You will be a blessing to your generation. You will fulfill the purpose of God. I speak to my household and I declare this season of struggle is ending. This season of oppression is broken. This season of the enemy's assignment against you is finished. You are entering into a season of victory. You are entering into a season of blessing. You are entering into a season of divine favor. The Lord your God has turned the tide. The Lord your God has broken the siege. The Lord your God is establishing his kingdom over you. I decree [music] that every attack of the enemy against my family is reversed. Every curse is converted to blessing. Every wound is being healed. Every broken place is being restored. Every stolen thing is being returned. Every lost thing is being found. Every dead thing is coming back to life. I command the heavens to release their blessing. I command the earth to yield its abundance. I command the doors of provision to open. I command the storehouses of God to release blessing upon my household. And this is the ultimate purpose of the 4:00 in the morning prayer. It is not just about your household being blessed. It is about your household being a light. It is about your family being a testimony. It is about your life glorifying God and drawing others into the kingdom. So, as you leave here today, as you listen to this word, understand what God is calling you to. Understand that the atmosphere over your household is not determined by your circumstances. It is determined by your intercession. It is determined by your decrees. It is determined by your commitment to prayer and holiness. The enemy has established strongholds over some of your families. The enemy has claimed some of your children. The enemy has corrupted some of your marriages. The enemy has stolen some of your blessings. But the 4:00 in the morning prayer is the weapon that will dislodge the enemy. The 4:00 in the morning prayer is the declaration that will shift the atmosphere. The 4:00 in the morning prayer is the warfare that will reclaim your territory. And I am telling you in the authority of Jesus Christ, if you will pray this prayer, if you will arise at the 4:00 in the morning, if you will decree with the authority of the kingdom of God, if you will stand in the gap for your family, if you will refuse to accept the judgment of the enemy, if you will believe the promises of God, then your household will be transformed. Your family will be blessed. Your destiny will be restored. The siege is over. The curse is broken. The victory is yours. Walk into the blessing of God. Walk into the favor of God. Walk into the restoration of God. I declare it. I speak it. I seal it in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
